data.name: Ibad
data.gender_notes: Ibad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Servant of Allah. The name Ibad carries the meaning “Servant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ibad usually hope their child will grow to embody servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Someone who follows the teachings and commandments of Allah
data.etymology: Ibad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عبد
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم يعبر عن العبادة والخضوع لله تعالى، مستمد من الجذر العربي عبد، ويحمل الدلالة على العبد الذي يخدم ربه بكل إخلاص، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي ليعبر عن التوجه الروحي والتوكل على الله

in_urdu.name: عبد
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی gốc سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اللہ کی عبادت اور بندگی کے معنی میں ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں یہ نام روحانی معنویت اور اللہ پر بھروسہ کرنے کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوا ہے

in_hindi.name: इबाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जो अल्लाह की उपासना और सेवा के अर्थ में है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम आध्यात्मिक अर्थ और अल्लाह पर भरोसा करने के प्रतीक के रूप में उपयोग किया गया है

in_pashto.name: عباد
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم عربي ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د الله عبادت او بندي کوونکي په معني کې دی، او په افغان/پښتنو دود کې دا نوم د روحاني معني او الله ته د اعتماد په نښه کې کارول شوی دی

in_english.name: Ibad
in_english.long_meaning: The name signifies devotion and servitude to Allah, derived from the Arabic root Abd, carrying the meaning of a servant who sincerely serves his Lord, and has been used in Islamic tradition to express spiritual devotion and reliance on Allah

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibad carries a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the Arabic root "abd" which means "servant." Historically, the term has been used to describe individuals who have devoted themselves completely to serving and following the teachings of Allah. This dedicated commitment to following God's commandments is a fundamental aspect of Islamic culture and the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ibad holds a great significance as it serves as a reminder of each individual's role as a servant of Allah. The name underscores the belief that every person is created to worship and serve their Creator, and that their actions and intentions should be deeply rooted in this fundamental purpose. It also embodies the essence of humility and submission to the will of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant" symbolizes Servant of Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ibad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibad ibn Samit was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the ten promised Paradise. The name Ibad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibad was a prominent figure in early Islamic history and is considered a saint in some Islamic traditions.

trends: Ibad is a common name among Arabs and Muslims.
There is a town in Yemen named after Ibad.
platforms: Ibad is a popular name on social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter.
There are several websites and blogs dedicated to Ibad and his life and teachings.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ibad remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Ibad in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Ibad, which means "Servant". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
